note: Precise, deterministic QA cases (senior manual + automation). Full protocol: tests/qa-catalog.md. tags: auto = covered by `npm run test:ui`; manual = eyes-on via ▶ Test / zoom; hybrid = both.

cases.title: Typography — fonts, fluid scale, no overflow
cases.description: Every text element uses the design's fonts (not a fallback), scales fluidly with the viewport, stays readable on a phone, and never overflows its box. (catalog §1)

checklist.text: h1 uses the design's DISPLAY font and it's loaded (not system fallback)
Body uses the design's BODY font and it's loaded
h1 font-size is strictly larger at 1920 than 320 (fluid clamp, not fixed)
Body font-size >= 14px at 320px
h1 doesn't exceed the desktop design size +10% at 3200px
No heading/paragraph overflows or is clipped by its box at ANY of the 14 widths
line-height is set (not normal); letter-spacing matches the token
No orphan single-word lines / broken headlines at 320 & 375
Every font-weight used (400/700/800…) has a loaded face of that weight

cases.title: Colour & contrast
cases.description: Text meets WCAG AA contrast; brand colours come from tokens; hover/focus/active states are visibly distinct. (catalog §2)

checklist.text: Body text contrast >= 4.5:1; large text >= 3:1
Links/buttons/headings use design-token colours (no off-palette hex)
Every link/button has a visible HOVER state
Every interactive element has a visible :focus-visible ring (>=3:1)
Buttons have a distinct pressed/active state

cases.title: Spacing & box model
cases.description: border-box everywhere; padding/margins scale proportionally; consistent scale; no fixed-px overflow. (catalog §3)

checklist.text: box-sizing: border-box on all elements
Section padding grows between 320 and 1920 (proportional --u)
Margins/paddings follow a consistent scale (no 13px/27px one-offs)
No cramped/overlapping content or unintended edge-touching at 320/375
No fixed-px width/margin overflows the viewport at 320

cases.title: Flexbox & grid
cases.description: Flex/grid wrap and align correctly; no track overflow; children can shrink. (catalog §4)

checklist.text: No flex/grid item's right edge exceeds its container at any width
Card/tile rows wrap or stack on narrow widths (not shrink-to-unreadable)
Flex/grid text children have min-width:0 (no blowout)
Multi-column sections collapse to one column at a sensible point; order stays logical
Gaps use `gap`, not margin hacks
Items align as designed (no accidental misalignment)

cases.title: Responsive at every width (320→3200)
cases.description: The page holds up at all 14 breakpoints — the undesigned ones are clean interpolations. (catalog §5)

checklist.text: No horizontal overflow at any of the 14 widths
No element wider than the viewport at any width
No zero-height / collapsed sections at any width
Undesigned widths (768/1024/1280/1440) are clean, not squished/stretched
Layout stable across the phone band (375/390/414)

cases.title: Images & media
cases.description: Correct dimensions, formats, sharpness and aspect ratio; lazy below the fold; alt text. (catalog §6)

checklist.text: Every image has width & height attributes (no CLS)
Below-the-fold images are lazy-loaded
Hero/LCP image is NOT lazy and uses fetchpriority=high
Raster images ship srcset / <picture> with webp/avif
Rendered aspect ratio within 6% of natural (no squash/stretch)
Images not upscaled beyond ~2.4x natural (no blur)
Every image has a non-null alt (empty only for decorative)
Inline SVG icons render with currentColor, crisp at all zooms

cases.title: Interactive elements (mouse + keyboard, zero-JS)
cases.description: Buttons/links/menus/accordions/carousels work, are keyboard-reachable, have visible states, and need no JavaScript. (catalog §7)

checklist.text: Every link/button has a destination or action (no dead controls)
Every interactive element has a visible hover state
Whole page is tab-reachable in logical order with a visible focus ring
Enter/Space activates the focused control
CTA tap targets >= 44x44px and not crowded on mobile
Accordions/FAQ expand & collapse without JavaScript, keyboard-operable
Carousels advance without JS (scroll-snap), no trapped focus
Mobile nav/menu is keyboard-operable and closes on Esc

cases.title: Motion
cases.description: Transitions are smooth, don't shift layout, and respect reduced-motion. (catalog §8)

checklist.text: Transitions/animations are smooth (transform/opacity), no jank
Animations don't cause layout shift (no animating width/top)
prefers-reduced-motion is respected

cases.title: Semantics, SEO & landmarks
cases.description: One h1, ordered headings, landmarks, title/meta, lang, canonical, structured data. (catalog §9)

checklist.text: Exactly one <h1> per page
Heading levels don't skip a step
<title> 50–60 chars; meta description 50–155 chars
header/nav/main/footer landmarks present; one <main>
<html lang> matches the page language
Canonical URL present; JSON-LD validates

cases.title: Performance & code
cases.description: Zero-JS, minified single stylesheet, weight budget, no CLS, clean console. (catalog §10)

checklist.text: Published <body> ships zero client-side <script>
One minified stylesheet, not many blocking requests
Total page weight within budget (~<1.5MB uncached)
Fonts are woff2, preconnected/preloaded
No layout shift (CLS) on load
No console/page errors in an editor + preview session

cases.title: Editor = Preview (WYSIWYG)
cases.description: The editor's device views ARE the published output; tag/style/translation edits render identically. (catalog §11)

checklist.text: Tablet/Mobile tabs render a real iframe at that width (correct media queries)
Editor Mobile is byte-identical to /preview @390 (stacks, not squished)
Retag (h1→h2) changes tag but NOT size/colour/margin/weight
Bounded style overrides ship in the export bundle and match the editor
Translation renders on canvas; source untouched; export honors active language

cases.title: Fidelity to the Figma design
cases.description: Matches the designed frames at desktop & mobile; nothing empty/placeholder; all sections present. (catalog §12)

checklist.text: @1920 matches the Figma desktop frame (baseline diff <= threshold)
@390 matches the Figma mobile frame
No empty / placeholder / lorem / TODO copy
All designed sections present, in pitforge.json order
Visual baselines exist per key page × {390,1440}; diffs reviewed on change
Chromium: all catalog sections pass
Firefox: layout/type/interaction parity
WebKit/Safari: check gap, clamp, backdrop-filter, sticky

cases.title: Translations (i18n)
cases.description: English source + per-key translations with fallback; source stays safe.

checklist.text: A new language can be added
A translated key renders in that language on the canvas
Untranslated keys fall back to English
Editing a translation never changes the English source

cases.title: Editor controls
cases.description: Every inspector control has an effect and a reset/undo path.

checklist.text: Semantic type picker changes tag, constrained per family
Align/weight/spacing/opacity/visibility apply as utility classes
Reset-to-design clears every override
Marketer=bounded (no raw hex/px); Builder unlocks free-form
Undo reverts the last change; redo re-applies
Repeat items add/remove within min–max

cases.title: Screens & routes
cases.description: Every screen and route loads without errors.

checklist.text: Home, projects API, previews, version routes respond
Dashboard, editor, preview, test overlay, export dialog render
No console/page errors in an editor session
